question: With which sports do you associate the India international, KM Beenamol?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Athletics.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__** 

__
 
• Kalayathumkuzhi Mathews Beenamol is an international **athlete from Kerala, India.**
 
• She won the gold medal in women's 800m and the 4 × 400 m women's relay in the 2002 Asian Games held at Busan. 
 
• She was the first woman athlete who got Arjuna award from Kerala in 2000.
 
• She was the first Malayali to win the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award in 2002-2003.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Athletics Federation of India is the apex body for running and managing athletics in India.
 
• The headquarters is located in New Delhi.
 
• The Athletics Federation of India nominated star javelin thrower Neeraj Chopra for the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award, the country's highest sporting honour.
 
• Adille Sumariwalla was elected as Athletics Federation of India (AFI) president for a third term.
 
• While former Indian athlete Anju Bobby George was elected as the senior vice-president.
 
• Madhukant Pathak and Ravinder Chaudhary were elected as treasurer and general secretary of AFI respectively.
